items.title: Data Storage and Management Concepts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Data Storage and Management Concepts' under topic 6.2 (PDF 78, printed 74).

blocks.text: Data storage ka matlab hai data ko baad ke istemal ke liye save karna. Data files, databases ya cloud systems (internet par servers) mein rakha ja sakta hai. Theek storage data ko zaya hone se bachati hai. Data management ka matlab hai data ko tarteeb se rakhna aur us ki dekh-bhaal karna, taake data aasani se mil jaye aur istemal ho sake. Security (hifazat) data management ka aham hissa hai. Backup systems (data ki doosri copy) data zaya hone se bachate hain. Achhi tarah sambhala hua data kaam ki raftar aur efficiency (kam mehnat mein zyada kaam) barhata hai, aur lambe arse tak kaam aata hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Data ka analysis karne se pehle yeh achhi tarah samajhna bohat zaroori hai ke data kis qism ka hai.

items: Data: raw facts (numbers, text, images, audio, video); is ki quality results par asar dalti hai.
Structured: rows aur columns; unstructured: koi muqarrar shakal nahi.
Sources: surveys, interviews, forms, sensors, online; manual ya automatic collection.
Storage: files, databases, cloud; management mein security aur backup.
